en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm lakeside or riverside scene. In the foreground are rocks, bushes, and a small tree by the water; a rowboat with a seated person is tied at the shore. Across the water, gently rolling, wooded hills rise behind a long multi‑storey building, possibly an institution or large house, with a few smaller structures nearby. The sky and water are smooth and reflective. Handwritten text in Swedish frames the image along the top and bottom margins.
